source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Review any inspection history logged on the system.
3. Observe the exterior of the building for fire hazards.
4. Check for smoke alarms.
5. Verify the emergency exit doors are not locked and a path is clear to evacuate.
6. View the status for required fire extinguishers (check for expiration).
7. Document all deficiencies and move on to the next one.

## Notes

- Step 1 – 4 are standard on every building inspection.
- Followed by a comprehensive review of the individual building based on type of construction and regulations in your jurisdiction.
